channel.title: Research Projects on Rouzbeh Haghighi
channel.description: Recent content in Research Projects on Rouzbeh Haghighi

item.title: Grid Integration of AI Data-Center Loads
item.description: Hosting capacity and reliability of distribution and transmission grids facing large, uncertain AI loads.

item.title: LLMs as Power-System Decision-Makers
item.description: Fine-tuned and multi-agent LLMs for scheduling, economic dispatch, Volt/VAR control, and network clustering.

item.title: Storage Investment and Carbon Policy under AI Load Growth
item.description: Game-theoretic and deep-RL models of second-life battery investment, EV charging, and carbon regulation.

item.title: Reliability Assessment under High IBR Penetration
item.description: Probabilistic reliability and resource-adequacy metrics for inverter-dominated grids (NSF Award #2321661).

item.title: Resilience of Distribution and Interdependent Infrastructure
item.description: Stochastic damage evaluation and resilience enhancement for distribution networks and coupled infrastructures.

item.title: Forecasting for Hybrid PV/Wind/Battery Microgrids
item.description: Machine-learning forecasts of wind, solar, load, and battery state of charge for microgrid energy management.

item.title: Cloud Energy Storage for Collaborating Microgrids
item.description: Shared storage invested in and operated by several microgrids, for profit, reliability, and congestion relief.

item.title: Generation Expansion Planning with Carbon Policy
item.description: Game-theoretic expansion planning with carbon tax, subsidies, and curtailment policies (M.Sc. research).

item.title: Optimization-Based MPPT under Partial Shading
item.description: Bio-inspired maximum power point tracking for PV panels under partial shading.
